Luxury safari lodge in Madikwe
Madikwe Hills Private Game Lodge
Be enchanted by a world of intrigue & majestic beauty in the heart of the Madikwe Game Reserve.
Link -->
Accommodating up to 24 guests in 10 expansive, well-spaced and totally private glass-fronted suites, as well as a two-bedroom private villa (called Little Madikwe), the lodge is scattered across the hillside and camouflaged by Tamboti trees. Wooden walkways connect the secluded suites to the central area, which includes a lounge, bar, wine cellar, TV room, dining room and a deck with a pool, overlooking the waterhole. The central area, located up a gentle slope, features cooling fans and a vaulted thatch ceiling supported by the large, twisted trunks of leadwood trees. Children above the age of 10 are welcome in the main lodge, while children of all ages are welcome in Little Madikwe.
Stay at Madikwe Hills
We offer luxurious suites with private plunge pools, and Little Madikwe – a private two-bedroom villa with its own game vehicle, guide and tracker, chef and house attendant.
Luxury Suites
10 uber-luxurious spacious suites with private decks and plunge pools, connected by raised interlinking wooden walkways.
Explore
Little Madikwe
An exclusive-use villa accommodating 4 guests, perfect for families and small groups looking for an unforgettable South African Safari. Two main lodge suites can be booked with the villa, for larger groups (up to 8 guests).
Explore
Explore Madikwe Game Reserve
The Madikwe Game Reserve, is a wilderness haven, home to 86 mammals including the Big 5, over 400 bird species and 104 tree species.

Big 5 Safari Destination
The Reserve
The malaria-free Madikwe Game Reserve covers about 75 000 hectares of bushland stretching all the way up to the Botswana border, and is one the largest and most popular game reserves in South Africa.

Our Activities
Madikwe Hills offers an array of safari activities, from twice-daily game drives led by experienced field guides and trackers, to gentle bush walks, allowing you to experience the African bush up-close-and-personal.

Safari Season Escape
Explore the Madikwe Game Reserve for less with our exclusive Stay 4 Pay 3 safari special in May and June 2026. Our lodge offers a peaceful wilderness retreat just a short flight or drive from Johannesburg, and with an extra night, you’ll have more time to unwind, explore, and enjoy the best of the bush – at your own pace.

SOUTH AFRICA SAFARI DESTINATION
Our Location
One of the most luxurious lodges in North West Province, Madikwe Hills is located in the middle of the Madikwe Game Reserve, approximately 4.5 hours drive from Johannesburg and Pretoria, the last hour of which is spent driving in the reserve.
Link -->
Situated near the Botswana border, the 75,000-hectare Madikwe Game Reserve is the fifth largest game reserve in South Africa. The reserve boasts a rich diversity of vegetation ensuring a wide range of game while the topography offers ideal game viewing opportunities. The reserve consists of vast plains of open woodlands and grasslands and is dotted with huge rocky outcrops known as inselbergs.
-->
-->
-->
Untamed Wilderness
Madikwe Game Reserve
It is one of few game reserves in the world that was proclaimed a wildlife reserve purely on the grounds of being the most appropriate and sustainable land area for such use. The Madikwe Game Reserve is bordered by Botswana on the northern boundary, Dwarsberg mountain range to the south, the main Gaborone/Zeerust road to the west and the Marico River to the east, with additional land protruding across to the eastern side of the Marico River.
Explore Madikwe Game Reserve
-->
-->
Getting to Madikwe Hills
Directions & Transfers
There are several ways to get to Madikwe Hills. If you choose to drive yourself, it is approximately a 3.5-hour journey from Johannesburg or Pretoria to the gate, followed by an additional hour to reach the lodge. However, it is important not to rely on GPS or Google Maps, as they do not yet provide the best directions. Instead, please download and follow our detailed instructions. Alternatively, you can take a 50-minute flight from O.R. Tambo International Airport, with a complimentary road transfer from the Madikwe Hills airstrip to the lodge. We also offer assistance with road transfers through our reliable partners for those preferring that option.

Madikwe Hills Private Game Lodge
About Us
Established in 2003, Madikwe Hills Private Game Lodge is situated in the Madikwe Game Reserve in South Africa s North West Province. The team aim to make you feel welcome, at home and part of the family.
Link -->
-->
-->
-->
About Us
Warm Hospitality
We have created a friendly and personal atmosphere at Madikwe Hills, offering as much relaxation and luxury for our guests as we possibly can. Formalities are kept to an absolute minimum. We have created the perfect balance between quality private-time and an opportunity to be social and meet new people from all around the globe. We have a total of 64 staff members who work on cycles. Three quarters of the staff are always on site and the other quarter are on leave.
-->
-->
About Us
Seasons in Africa
Seasons in Africa, a premier tourism marketing and management company, comprising, luxury game lodges (Leopard Hills Private Game Reserve, Kings Camp Private Game Reserve and Tuningi Safari Lodge), hotels and adventures throughout Southern Africa, Seasons in Africa markets Madikwe Hills to the local and International market. Each of the properties within the Seasons group not only offers all the facilities one expects, but also warm, friendly and personalised service!
Explore
History of Madikwe Hills
A Welcome Sanctuary in the African Bush
In 2003 the five owners, Louis Kruger, Jack Brotherton, Carl Trieloff, Hector Magome and William Stephens, joined forces and invested in the Madikwe Game Reserve. Many days were spent exploring the proposed koppie, envisaging which room would go where, where to build the main lodge, boma, spa, gym, reception and staff quarters and how the high wooden walkways would link them.
An architect was hired to draw up plans, but it soon became apparent that one could not build from the original plans in the bush, especially not on a koppie! The plans were thrown into the fire and new plans were drawn up for each unique suite. Striving to keep all the suites completely private and more importantly, keeping the environment as untouched as possible, each suite was ingeniously fitted between rocks, trees and overhangs which created an amazing feeling of genuinely living within the surroundings.
It took a year and a half to build Madikwe Hills, a very challenging feat… Due to the typography, no truck could get close to where most of the foundations needed to be laid, so the builders carried most of the materials and equipment from a drop off point to the building site. Hard to comprehend now, walking on the raised wooden walkways (the last part of the project) linking the suites to the main lodge and reception.
Madikwe Hills opened its doors to the public in August 2004.

Conservation

Our Community
